en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Baroque‑Renaissance palace complex bordering a broad paved square. Several ornate corner towers and a tall central spire rise above the roofline. In the foreground stands a large monument with an obelisk and sculptural figures. Small groups of people in early 20th‑century clothing walk in the square. The caption at the top reads in red Gothic script: "Dresden. Königl. Schloss." and a vertical imprint at the left margin shows the publisher information.
